nodes.description: Address of the contract owner (OwnableData.owner); controls all onlyOwner functions.
Address nominated as the next owner in the two-step ownership transfer (OwnableData.pendingOwner).
Immutable IERC20 reward token (ESW) distributed by the farming contract.
Amount of ESW vested per second; mutable by the owner via setEswPerSecond.
Array of PoolInfo structs holding staking token, total staked amount, accEswPerShare, lastRewardTime and allocPoint.
Mapping pid => user => UserInfo with amount, rewardDebt and remainingEswTokenReward.
Sum of allocation points of all pools; used as divisor in reward math.
Immutable timestamp when ESW farming starts.
Timestamp at which reward accrual stops; extendable by the owner via changeEndTime.
onlyOwner function that directly transfers ownership or sets pendingOwner for the two-step flow.
Public function where the pending owner claims ownership; requires msg.sender == pendingOwner.
onlyOwner function that extends endTime by addSeconds, altering future reward distribution.
onlyOwner function that changes the ESW emission rate, optionally mass-updating pools first.
View function returning the number of registered pools.
onlyOwner function adding a new staking pool with an allocation point and setting lastRewardTime.
onlyOwner function updating the allocation point of an existing pool.
View helper computing the time-based reward multiplier between _from and _to, bounded by startTime/endTime.
View function computing pending ESW rewards for a user in a pool.
Public loop that calls updatePool for every pool.
Public function refreshing accEswPerShare and lastRewardTime of a pool based on elapsed time and emission rate.
Public function staking tokens into a pool, harvesting pending rewards and updating user accounting.
Public function withdrawing staked tokens and pending rewards; external transfers occur before user state is zeroed/reduced.
Public emergency withdrawal of the full staked amount, forfeiting rewards; transfers before clearing user state.
Internal function transferring ESW rewards and returning the remainder owed when the contract balance is insufficient.
Caller-controlled address used as owner check, user key and transfer recipient.
Miner-influenceable timestamp driving reward accrual, pool lastRewardTime and endTime logic.
External ERC20 safeTransferFrom call pulling the staking token from the depositor in deposit().
External ERC20 safeTransfer of the staking token to the user inside withdraw(), executed before user.amount is reduced.
External ERC20 safeTransfer of ESW rewards to the user inside safeRewardTransfer().
External ERC20 safeTransfer of the full staked amount in emergencyWithdraw() before state reset.
Amount of staking tokens the caller deposits in deposit().
Pool id selected by the caller in deposit().
Amount of staking tokens the caller withdraws in withdraw().
Pool id selected by the caller in withdraw().
Allocation points assigned to a new pool in add().
ERC20 token address registered as the staking token in add().
Seconds added to endTime in changeEndTime().
New ESW-per-second emission rate set in setEswPerSecond().
New owner or pending owner address passed to transferOwnership().
Start of the reward interval in getMultiplier().
End of the reward interval in getMultiplier().
Recipient of the ESW reward payout in safeRewardTransfer().
Requested ESW reward amount in safeRewardTransfer().
Pending ESW amount computed for the user in deposit() before it is forwarded to safeRewardTransfer().
Pending ESW amount computed for the user in withdraw() before it is forwarded to safeRewardTransfer().
Snapshot of user.amount used to pay out the full stake in emergencyWithdraw().
Time multiplier returned by getMultiplier and used to compute eswReward in updatePool().
Locally recomputed accEswPerShare in pendingEsw() used for the pending view calculation.
Current ESW balance of the contract read in safeRewardTransfer() to cap the payout.

edges.reason: transferOwnership is guarded by onlyOwner which compares msg.sender to owner.
claimOwnership requires msg.sender to equal pendingOwner for the transfer to succeed.
changeEndTime is restricted to the owner via the onlyOwner modifier.
setEswPerSecond is restricted to the owner via the onlyOwner modifier.
add is restricted to the owner via the onlyOwner modifier.
set is restricted to the owner via the onlyOwner modifier.
msg.sender is the user key used to read and write userInfo in deposit.
msg.sender identifies the withdrawing user and the staking token recipient in withdraw.
msg.sender identifies the user and payout recipient in emergencyWithdraw.
block.timestamp selects lastRewardTime of a new pool, creating timestamp-dependent initialization.
getMultiplier clamps the interval with startTime/endTime comparisons and is timestamp-dependent.
pendingEsw branches on block.timestamp versus pool.lastRewardTime to accrue rewards.
updatePool requires block.timestamp > lastRewardTime and stores block.timestamp, making accrual miner-influenceable.
transferOwnership reads owner for the OwnershipTransferred event and writes the new owner.
transferOwnership writes pendingOwner when the transfer is not direct.
claimOwnership reads and clears pendingOwner when the caller is the pending owner.
safeRewardTransfer reads the ESW token contract to query balance and pay rewards.
setEswPerSecond writes the eswPerSecond emission rate.
updatePool reads eswPerSecond to compute the pool reward.
add pushes a new PoolInfo entry into poolInfo.
set reads and updates allocPoint of the selected pool in poolInfo.
pendingEsw reads pool.accEswPerShare, lastRewardTime, allocPoint and total staked amount.
massUpdatePools iterates over poolInfo.length to update every pool.
updatePool reads and writes accEswPerShare and lastRewardTime of the pool.
deposit reads pool.accEswPerShare and updates pool.stakingTokenTotalAmount.
withdraw reads pool reward state and decrements pool.stakingTokenTotalAmount.
emergencyWithdraw reads and decrements pool.stakingTokenTotalAmount.
pendingEsw reads the user's amount, rewardDebt and remainingEswTokenReward.
deposit reads and writes the caller's UserInfo entry.
withdraw reads and writes the caller's UserInfo entry.
emergencyWithdraw reads and resets the caller's UserInfo entry.
add increases totalAllocPoint by the new pool allocation.
set adjusts totalAllocPoint when the pool allocation changes.
pendingEsw divides the reward by totalAllocPoint as a divisor.
updatePool divides the computed reward by totalAllocPoint as a divisor.
add compares block.timestamp with the immutable startTime to initialize lastRewardTime.
getMultiplier floors the interval start at the immutable startTime.
changeEndTime extends the endTime state variable.
getMultiplier caps the reward interval at endTime.
setEswPerSecond optionally calls massUpdatePools before changing the emission rate.
add optionally calls massUpdatePools before registering the new pool.
set optionally calls massUpdatePools before changing the allocation.
massUpdatePools loops and calls updatePool for each pool id.
updatePool calls getMultiplier to compute the elapsed-time multiplier.
deposit calls updatePool before harvesting and crediting the stake.
withdraw calls updatePool before computing and paying out pending rewards.
pendingEsw calls getMultiplier to project the reward up to the current timestamp.
deposit forwards the computed pending reward to safeRewardTransfer.
withdraw forwards the computed pending reward to safeRewardTransfer.
deposit performs an external ERC20 safeTransferFrom before updating user and pool accounting.
withdraw performs an external ERC20 safeTransfer to the user before reducing user.amount and pool total.
emergencyWithdraw performs an external ERC20 safeTransfer before clearing user state.
safeRewardTransfer performs external ESW safeTransfer calls to pay the reward or the remaining balance.
A malicious staking token can re-enter deposit during safeTransferFrom before accounting is finalized.
A malicious staking token can re-enter withdraw during safeTransfer while user.amount is still unreduced.
A malicious staking token can re-enter emergencyWithdraw before user.amount is zeroed.
The ESW token callback could re-enter safeRewardTransfer; the token is set at construction and treated as trusted.
_amount parameter is used for the transferFrom and added to user.amount and pool total in deposit.
_pid parameter indexes poolInfo and userInfo in deposit.
_amount parameter bounds the staking token transfer and is subtracted from user.amount in withdraw.
_pid parameter indexes poolInfo and userInfo in withdraw.
_allocPoint is stored as the new pool allocation and added to totalAllocPoint in add.
_stakingToken is stored as the pool's staking token in add.
addSeconds is added to endTime in changeEndTime.
_eswPerSecond is written to the eswPerSecond state variable in setEswPerSecond.
newOwner is written to owner or pendingOwner in transferOwnership.
_from is clamped against startTime and used as the interval start in getMultiplier.
_to is compared with endTime and used as the interval end in getMultiplier.
_to is the ESW reward recipient in safeRewardTransfer.
_amount is compared with the contract balance and paid out in safeRewardTransfer.
The local pending reward from deposit is passed into safeRewardTransfer.
The local pending reward from withdraw is passed into safeRewardTransfer.
userAmount snapshot is the value transferred out in emergencyWithdraw.
The multiplier local is computed inside updatePool and feeds the eswReward computation.
The locally recomputed accEswPerShare is used to compute the pending ESW in pendingEsw.
eswTokenBalance is read from the ESW token inside safeRewardTransfer and caps the payout.

Function parameter used only to index pools inside deposit(); it can be merged into deposit().
Function parameter used only to size the transfer and accounting update inside withdraw().
Function parameter used only to index pools inside withdraw().
Function parameter consumed only by the add() core function when creating a pool.
Function parameter consumed only by the add() core function when creating a pool.
Function parameter consumed only by the changeEndTime() core function.
Function parameter consumed only by the setEswPerSecond() core function.
Function parameter consumed only by the transferOwnership() core function.
Function parameter consumed only by the getMultiplier() core function.
Function parameter consumed only by the getMultiplier() core function.
Function parameter consumed only by the safeRewardTransfer() core function.
Function parameter consumed only by the safeRewardTransfer() core function.
Local temporary computed inside deposit() and immediately forwarded to safeRewardTransfer; no cross-function meaning.
Local temporary computed inside withdraw() and immediately forwarded to safeRewardTransfer; no cross-function meaning.
Local snapshot that is exactly the value passed to the unsafe external transfer in emergencyWithdraw().
Local calculated inside updatePool() from getMultiplier and used only for that pool's reward computation.
Local shadow of accEswPerShare computed inside pendingEsw() solely for the view calculation.
Local balance read inside safeRewardTransfer() that governs the unsafe ESW transfer amount.
